home.subhead: Two native apps. One design language.
home.intro: Interactive browser demos of RunProcess for macOS and ProcessSH for Windows.
footer.note: Pure frontend. Simulated interactions. Open source.
rp.tagline: A Spotlight-style command launcher with real shell execution and a translucent interface.
rp.demo.title: Try it
rp.demo.desc: This is a simulated demo. Commands return preset output — nothing runs on your machine.
rp.appearance.title: Appearance
rp.appearance.desc: RunProcess supports three window materials. Liquid Glass is available on macOS 26 and later.
rp.features.title: Features
rp.f1: Command execution with ANSI color output
rp.f2: Tab completion from history, aliases, and system commands
rp.f4: Sudo mode with simulated password dialog
rp.f5: Session mode with persistent shell (macOS native)
rp.shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
ps.tagline: A Windows port of RunProcess — PowerShell 7, system tray, and Mica materials.
ps.demo.title: Try it
ps.demo.desc: Simulated demo. Preset commands return mock output.
ps.appearance.title: Window Material
ps.appearance.desc: Mica and Acrylic require Windows 11. The demo uses frosted glass as a web approximation.
ps.features.title: Features
ps.f2: Tab completion and fuzzy history search (Ctrl+R)
ps.f4: Custom paths appended to PATH with PATHEXT resolution
ps.f5: System tray integration, no taskbar icon
ps.shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
